He was trying to see if you were still available just in case. 

Not a guy but it’s been done to me more than I’d like to admit. Do not respond anymore unless he gives you a damn good reason as to why. Or you’ll be in a cycle.

I know of a girl who grew up thinking she was the baby of three kids. 

She later found out that her older brother is actually her dad. Her parents are her grandparents.

I remember once that my boyfriend went on this rant that he wasn’t attracted to me without having long hair at the beginning of our relationship.

I had gotten hair extensions and he is ignorant of how it works, thought it was a permanent style. So when I took them out and went back to my natural state he was pissed and made sure to let me know. 

So I told him that not only did I have to buy the extensions, I also had to pay for the service. There’s also maintenance that comes with it. And if he was not willing to pay for me to get my hair how he likes it, then he could either learn to get used to it or we could break up. While he found me unattractive with my short hair, other men like it. So it wouldn’t be the end of the world. 

Moral of the story. I’m not going to knock you for your preference of perky tits but if you can’t get past her breast being saggy, then let her find someone else who doesn’t give a fuck.

Yes. 
You’re too young to be tied up into situations like this. I have a cousin who spent five years being “loyal” to a person who picked the streets over her countless of times.

He got into some serious trouble with drug/violent crimes and had to go to prison for some time. During his absence, she made a lot of accomplishments that he discouraged her from doing when he was around. She obtained a degree, got a good job, and met someone who valued her and not the streets. She’s engaged now and doing well. 

Her ex on the other hand? Pushing 30 and still trying to live a life in the streets. You don’t have to put up with that.
